overview_description.description: Stitch develops payment infrastructure and financial technology tools that support online and in-person transactions for businesses. The company provides APIs and payment solutions for bank transfers, card payments, recurring billing, payouts, and financial data connectivity. Its platform enables businesses to manage payment processing, customer authentication, reconciliation, and transaction reporting through integrated systems and developer tools. Stitch also supports checkout customization, fraud monitoring, and payment orchestration across multiple financial service providers. The company works with enterprises and digital platforms across sectors such as retail, financial services, and commerce to support payment operations and money movement processes.

about_short_description.short_description: Stitch develops payment infrastructure and financial technology tools that support online and in-person transactions for businesses.

product.name: Onboarding & Origination Platform
product.description: A platform that enables businesses to design, automate, and manage customer onboarding workflows with compliance and decisioning capabilities.

product.name: Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) Infrastructure
product.description: Software to launch and manage the full lifecycle of BNPL products including onboarding, credit checks, disbursement, repayment tracking, and settlement.

product.name: Card Issuing and Management Software
product.description: Software for issuing and managing prepaid, debit, and credit cards with lifecycle management, security features, and multi-currency support.

product.name: Deposit Account Software
product.description: A system to create and manage various deposit products including stored value and fixed-term accounts with multi-currency and real-time transaction processing.

identifier.value: Loan Management, Origination, and Collection System

product.name: Loan Management, Origination, and Collection System
product.description: A platform to issue and manage conventional and Islamic loans with real-time credit decisioning, flexible repayment, and compliance features.

product.name: Stitch BNPL
product.description: A BNPL offering that lets customers split purchases into 2–6 instalments while merchants get paid within 24 hours.
